title: failed float, text and byte assertions make the test run exit 1
purpose: Run embedded tests whose float, text and byte assertions fail.

expect.justification: The embedded test runner's report format is not normative (spec 14 fixes only the exit status).

provenance.origin: authored for #187 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 14: 1.0 and 1.5 are 0.5 apart, beyond 0.1; a negative tolerance fails; the texts part at scalar 5; the byte arrays differ in size; the CLI returns 1 when any test fails.
